criteria.feedback: What changed in the business? Tell me that, not which account moved.

criteria.passes_when: Gives a dollar amount for each driver named, or says how much is still unexplained
criteria.feedback: Put a dollar amount on each driver, or say how much is still unexplained.
criteria.why: Lets the arithmetic check test the drivers and shows a partial explanation for what it is
criteria.question: Does the commentary give a dollar amount for each driver it names, or say how much is still unexplained?

criteria.passes_when: Says when the driver happened: a date, a week, or the month it started or ended
criteria.feedback: When did this happen? Give the date or the week, so I can match it to cutoff.
criteria.why: Cutoff is the first question an auditor asks about a movement
criteria.example: after Lumen filed for Chapter 11 on Jul 9
criteria.question: Does the commentary say when the driver happened?

rejected.why: No yes-or-no test a reader could apply. Every line the reviewer called unclear lacked a named driver, which C1 already checks.

rejected.draft: The explanation agrees with the GL detail
rejected.why: Asks whether the explanation is true. The Coach checks whether commentary can be reviewed; tying it to the GL is the review itself.

sample.commentary: Subscription revenue increased due to growth.
sample.reason: 'Growth' is a category, not a driver, and nothing says whether it repeats or where to look.

sample.commentary: Up $188K on three drivers: Orion Freight's three-year subscription started Jul 1 ($135K a month), Cobalt Insurance added 120 seats ($41K a month), and price uplifts on 14 renewals added $12K. All three recur from August. Support: Orion order form OF-2291, Cobalt amendment CA-07 and the July billing register.

Usage revenue fell $29K because Bluewater Health paused its nightly sync jobs for two weeks during its records-system migration. Usage resumed Jul 20, so August should recover. See the July usage report UR-0726.
Professional services revenue increased $55K, driven by implementation milestones.
sample.reason: Which milestone, signed off when? Nothing on whether more are coming or where the sign-off is.
Timing of what? No driver, no amount, nothing to pull.

sample.commentary: Up $118K for our Gold sponsorship of DataOps Summit in Boston (Jul 15 to 17): $95K sponsorship fee and $23K booth build. One-time; no events are booked for August. See invoice DOS-2614 and booth vendor PO 4482.
Payroll taxes increased $34K, or 10.9%, versus June.
sample.reason: Only repeats the row: the account, the direction and the size.

sample.commentary: Up $82K because we reserved the full Lumen Retail receivable ($82K, invoices from April to June) after Lumen filed for Chapter 11 on Jul 9. One-time unless we recover something in the bankruptcy. See the July AR aging and JE 7-090.
